name: Eva Di Pierro
title: Executive presence coach and leadership development specialist
bio_short: Executive presence coach and leadership development specialist with more than 15 years' experience across Europe, the United States and Asia. Certified Somatic Experiencing Practitioner. Coaches CEOs and senior executives on presence.
bio: Eva is an executive presence coach and leadership development specialist with more than 15 years' experience working with CEOs, founders and senior executives across Europe, the United States and Asia. She specialises in helping leaders develop the physical composure, clarity and authority that underpin effective executive communication.  Her approach integrates body-based awareness with executive performance coaching. As a certified Somatic Experiencing Practitioner with advanced training in developmental psychology, Eva brings a distinctive methodology that helps leaders recognise how physical patterns of tension, breathing and posture influence their communication, decision-making and presence under pressure. Her long-term coaching clients include the president of an $8 billion US corporation and the CEO of a leading finance and capital markets company.  At ISOC, Eva coaches senior executives and delivers executive presence programmes that help leaders strengthen their communication presence, composure and impact in high-stakes environments. She is particularly effective with leaders managing transitions, high-profile stakeholder relationships or communication challenges that require more than technical skill. Eva delivers programmes internationally in English and Italian. Her work bridges the gap between conventional leadership coaching and the deeper physical dimensions of executive communication. Eva is based in Italy and trains in English.
